title: Red Robin Offers Free Burger and Bottomless Steak Fries to Military Heroes This Veterans Day

body_markdown:
*Veterans and active-duty military members are invited to dine in for a complimentary Red's Big Tavern Burger and* Bottomless Steak Fries *on Nov. 11*


**KEY POINTS:**


- Red Robin is offering veterans and active-duty military members a complimentary Red's Big Tavern Burger with Bottomless Steak Fries on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026.
- The Red Robin Veterans Day offer is available to veterans and active-duty military members with a valid military ID or proof of service for dine-in at participating Red Robin restaurants nationwide.
- Throughout November, guests can participate in Red Robin's Buy a Veteran a Gift Card program by purchasing a gift card at participating restaurants, which will be donated to local veteran organizations to provide meals for veterans in communities across the country.


ENGLEWOOD, Colo.


, Oct. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Red Robin Gourmet Burgers, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804074-1&h=282250020&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.redrobin.com%2F&a=Red+Robin+Gourmet+Burgers%2C+Inc.) (NASDAQ: RRGB) is expressing its gratitude to all the brave military heroes this Veterans Day by offering a complimentary meal to veterans and active-duty military members on Nov. 11*.


Red Robin is continuing its tradition of honoring veterans and active-duty military members with a complimentary Red's Big Tavern Burger served with Bottomless Steak Fries at participating restaurants across the country. To redeem the offer, guests must present a valid military ID or proof of service for dine-in only.


The Red's Big Tavern Burger features a made-to-order flat-top grilled beef patty topped with melted American cheese, Red's Secret Sauce, fresh lettuce and vine-ripened tomato on a toasted brioche bun. Substitutions, additions or premium sides are available for an additional charge.


"For years, we've had the privilege of welcoming veterans and active-duty military heroes to dine with us on Veterans Day as a small gesture of our gratitude, and we're honored to do that again this year," said Dave Pace, CEO and president of Red Robin. "We're proud to show our appreciation for veterans and active-duty military members, both on Veterans Day and throughout the year."


Throughout November, guests can also support veterans through Red Robin's Buy a Veteran a Gift Card program. Guests can purchase gift cards at participating Red Robin restaurants that will be donated to local veteran organizations to provide meals for veterans in communities across the country.


To learn more about Red Robin's Veterans Day offer and Buy a Veteran a Gift Card program, please visit[RedRobin.com/Veterans-Day](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804074-1&h=1489378527&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.redrobin.com%2Fveterans-day&a=RedRobin.com%2FVeterans-Day) .


*** *Offer valid for one free Red's Big Tavern Burger on Wednesday, 11/11/26 only. Dine-in only at participating Red Robin restaurants. Valid for veterans and active-duty military members with valid military ID or proof of service. No purchase necessary. Offer excludes modifications and other burger styles. Not valid with any other offer or discount, including Red Robin Royalty* *®* *rewards.*
